en: A black‑and‑white view over a leafy city park with winding paths and a small pond in the foreground. Behind the trees stand several multi‑storey residential or institutional buildings. On the left rises a large Gothic church with a tall central tower and steeply pitched roofs. On the right, atop a hill, is a large, ornate castle‑like complex with multiple wings, domes, and towers, overlooking the town below. The scene suggests a historic European city landscape. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the front.
